context_build.causal_mechanism: Test whether leftover global-hike consensus after the delivered September 16 Fed 25bp move is being imported into Canada policy-path pricing that Canada's own labor, consumer, and core-inflation evidence cannot support. Mechanism: a one-way US tightening narrative plus BoC energy-pass-through language keeps 2027 CORRA implied rates 84-130bp above overnight CORRA 2.29 even though Canada inflation held at 3% with core near 2%. If that imported hawkishness fades, the 2027 CORRA window is the tenor that must reprice lower.

Available ownership proxies only: (1) consensus pricing — Reuters greater-than-90% Fed hike odds into a delivered decision, leftover SR3 +90bp and CORRA +84 to +130bp; (2) the only non-null futures open interest in the packet is ASX AONIA, concentrated in 2026-10 (21752) and 2026-09 (11896), i.e. the front AU hike is the owned contract; every CORRA and SR3 open_interest field is null. context_build.known_vs_new_information: Known before this freeze: hike odds above 90%, August US CPI, Canada August CPI at 3% / core near 2%, BoC minutes energy-pass-through language, AU housing slump. Temperature gauges are repo-retained dashboard_v8, not a fresh live print.
context_build.market_assumption_disagreed_with: Disagree that Canada must deliver that 2027 catch-up path. Canada core-near-2% and labor 38 do not require that path; energy-tail risk is reduced in the same packet. Do not disagree that US data can still support more Fed hikes — that is the crowded object I refuse to join.
context_build.market_implied_assumption: The 2027 CORRA strip assumes Canada delivers roughly +84bp by Mar-2027 and +130bp by Dec-2027 from 2.29 overnight, a larger basis-point hiking cycle than SR3 asks of the US from 3.85 (+73bp by Mar-2027, +90.5bp by Sep-2027). That prices a BoC catch-up cycle despite cooler Canada gauges (inflation 55 / labor 38 / activity 66 / consumer 45) versus hot US gauges (72 / 75 / 69 / 74).
context_build.path_to_current_price: Known path: Reuters recorded greater-than-90% odds of a 25bp Fed hike into the September 16 FOMC; August CPI had already kept a tightening bias intact; the Fed then raised the target range to 3.75-4.00%. CA 2Y is 3.27 and CA-US 2Y printed -140bp on 2026-09-17 after a -17bp 1m move. USDCAD is 1.401, +1.74% 1m. Unknown: trader-class nets on CAD, SOFR, or CRA.
